name: Tinker beacons share one charge pool (#4746)
contract: SpellCharges.dbc puts all 9 beacon spells (560750 Replenishment, 560754 Alarm, 801799/803799-803803 Shield ranks, 801801 Restorative) in Category 13 (SpellChargesCategory.dbc: 3 charges, 15000 ms recharge), and the tooltip says Shield Beacon 'Shares a cooldown with other Beacons'.
